acceptanceCriteria: 未声明或不完整 node read-set 禁止复用；在 composition JSON 不变时更改命令可读源码或被执行的相对 executable 会重跑受影响节点。
仅登记的 integration owner 可获组合准入；必须从 digest 匹配的真实 Contract 验证声明完整必需检查，伪造标签、遗漏检查或不可信 satisfied 布尔值在任何进程启动前被拒绝。
真实进程在 invalidation 持久化后、registration 完成前被终止后，可重试协调成功且只存在一份有效影响事件；不一致状态保持 fail-closed，活跃锁持有者不会被驱逐。
最终 evidence 文件或任意父目录 symlink 越出登记 worktree 时，发布/登记/检查均拒绝，外部字节不成为证据。
相同 outcomeId 的不同 provider 不会交叉影响动作准入；动作按 provider/outcome 对精确选取。
真实 CLI 流程证明相同可信输入可从一个验证进程降至零；composition JSON 不变但实际观测输入变化时重跑受影响节点，且只复用读集合确定未变的节点。
MCP 每个 coordination action 的身份字段语义唯一，并有 CLI/MCP parity 与 gate manifest 回归保护。
多个真实进程与 linked worktree 的协作验收通过，普通单 WI 串行路径也通过 Runtime CLI + Cargo/CI canonical gate。
candidate Runtime CLI 对 Sentinel 的只读兼容检查通过，前后 Git tree、Contract/evidence、生命周期 Runtime 和 coordination store 均不变。

CLI/MCP inspection、status/outcome projection 与 dependency query 不创建或修改持久 coordination 记录；request-scoped observation consistency 不宣称跨进程事件传递，持久变化只经显式 registration、impact/publication、coordination、recovery 写入口发生并由前后字节断言。

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run repository composition identity regressions and prove undeclared readable inputs and changed relative executables cannot reuse stale results.
Run admission regressions proving a non-owner and incomplete or caller-forged checks are rejected before process spawn.
Kill a real child process after impact persistence and prove a fresh process reconciles one event without evicting a live lock owner.
Run filesystem regressions for final and parent symlinks escaping the registered worktree and assert no event is appended.
Use two providers with the same outcome identifier and assert action admission selects only the exact provider and outcome pair.
Run real CLI composition twice unchanged and once after changing an observed source or environment while keeping JSON byte-identical; count spawned processes and reusable nodes.
Run MCP CLI parity tests and compare durable coordination bytes before and after read queries; verify only explicit write actions persist events.
Run the registered multiple-process linked-worktree acceptance and ordinary serial path, then inspect Sentinel with the candidate CLI and verify its protected state is byte-identical.
